correctness.rationale: Properness makes the center color fresh and makes each outer vertex automatically satisfy the parity rule. The center condition is exactly that every outer color class has odd size. Necessity of the allowed color counts follows from parity and the per-edge size cap; sufficiency follows by choosing odd class sizes at most k and pairing the 2k colored tokens across distinct color classes using a perfect matching in a complete multipartite graph. Exhaustive canonical partitions for k=2..5 independently reproduce the spectrum.

value.rationale: Friendship graphs are a canonical infinite block-graph family, and the result gives the complete feasible color-count spectrum rather than another isolated optimum. It exposes an exact parity phase transition at the center and cleanly separates what a general block-graph optimization algorithm already covers (the minimum) from the additional structural information (every attainable color count).
